faqs.question: Can we customize our corporate or brand logo on FS-137?
faqs.answer: Yes. Note that our factory does NOT recommend surface silk-screen or UV ink printing on metal because smooth, chemically inert metal surfaces lack ink adhesion and peel off under thumb friction. Instead, we recommend two permanent methods on FS-137: (1) 50W Fiber Laser Engraving for monochrome logos (+$0.15–$0.30/pc, $0 setup, 100 pcs MOQ, $50 USD sample fee), and (2) Deep Laser Engraving + Color Fill for colored logos (+$0.35–$0.60/pc, 100–200 pcs MOQ, $80–$150 USD sample fee), where the laser carves a recessed cavity filled with cured enamel so the color never peels.

faqs.question: How is internal mechanical hardware secured inside FS-137 for US CPSC and RoHS safety compliance?
faqs.answer: FS-137 is 100% magnet-free (zero neodymium magnets), eliminating magnet ingestion hazards and IATA PI953 magnetic shielding surcharges. Its mechanical assemblies (1 pc Precision Ball Bearing 12.7*4.75MM, 1 pc M4×8mm Machine Screw) are locked with thread-locked machine screws and structural retention, passing EU RoHS 3, REACH, and California Prop 65 compliance.
